title: Push changes from data model yml files in git repo to sigma
description:
The purpose of the sync is to push changes from the data model configs in github up to sigma. We need to detect which files have changes that are not present in the published version, then make an API call to update the data model with the new config. The version and schema number should be updated once the chagnes arepublished.
